description: ROBOTIS's tabletop robot arm: five XM430-W350 servos (four arm joints plus the gripper), 380 mm of reach, run from a PC or an OpenCR over a TTL multidrop bus. It has no onboard battery — a 12 V DC supply powers it. Values are from the ROBOTIS e-Manual specification page; link masses from the official URDF.

wiring.note: The OpenManipulator-X has no battery: the documented pattern is a 12 V DC supply feeding the controller (PC or OpenCR), which powers the five XM430-W350-T servos over the TTL multidrop bus — the bus carries both power and data on the same chain. Voltages are the e-Manual's specified 12 V input throughout. Harness-check data (2026-10-27): the bus is a TTL-level multidrop bus (OpenManipulator-X specification) at the Dynamixel 5 V TTL logic level (ROBOTIS X-series documentation); the OpenCR's 12 V output is rated at 4.5 A maximum (OpenCR e-Manual); the bus cables terminate in the same Robot Cable-X3P plug at both ends (ROBOTIS cable table). Servo load currents stay unrecorded — ROBOTIS publishes stall current only for the XM430-W350, a peak its manual says is not a continuous rating.
